_roster_doc: each slot is a unit line: its first age (`tier`), the building that trains it, its name on the tech tree page, and `last_age` when it stops before the last age. Slots with "status": "planned" are only on the page: the generator skips them (milestone 12)

combat.stance_note: stances (combat.gd): defensive units engage foes within defend_sight (or their reach, if longer) and give up once leash from where they stood, then walk back (leash stays above defend_sight, or they would turn back short of a foe that stands still).
combat.note: ticks at 20 Hz; distances in milli-tiles. Damage = max(min_damage, sum over attack classes the target has of max(0, attack - armour)).

movement.note: Movement classes (sim_map.gd CLASSES): a unit takes the first class whose tag it has, else ground. Terrains list which classes cross them (terrain.json move).

fog.note: sight radii in tiles; the fog grid updates every `every` ticks (5 Hz)
